text:
Maria: heads-up — planning to lift the runtime pin for runtime/3.2 in eu-west during the 23:00-02:00 UTC night window. deploybot currently auto-pins SDK 2.7 when it sees a runtime/signature mismatch. i'd like to change the pinning heuristic to prefer regional fallback routing for longseq/quant groups instead of an immediate pin. cc @Sam @Natalie

deploybot: Auto-pin detected on release attempt -> sdk=2.7 pinned runtime=3.1. Action queued (id=pin-4123456789).

Sam: what telemetry thresholds should decide pin vs fallback? do we gate on latency p95, error_rate, or a compat_score from the SDK?

Kevin: oncall note — please avoid changing pin heuristics without a rollback runbook. if we flip heuristics during night, add a deadman timer + a manual kill switch.

Maria: agreed. proposal: heuristics change to use an SDK-supplied `compat_score` and model_group tags. logic: if compat_score >= 0.8 allow soft-unpin (route to runtime/3.2); else fallback to regional_variant. add deadman_minutes=30 and a kill-switch flag.

Natalie: i can add the SDK shim to surface compat_score in the handshake. i'll open a PR to add the console flag and a release-notes checklist item.

Sam: can we canary this in eu-staging -> eu-west (1%) for 2h first? deploybot supports `--heuristics=beta` flag. want a small canary and then ramp.

Maria: runbook sketch: monitor latency_p95 and error_rate. rollback heuristics and re-pin if: error_rate > 2% OR latency_p95 > 2x baseline for 15m. rollback command (ops): `deployctl pin --runtime=3.1 --reason='heuristics-regression'`

deploybot: Canary scheduled: eu-west -> 1% traffic using heuristics=beta at 23:10 UTC. Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood/d/ops/compat (dashboard id: compat-ops-3.2)

Kevin: ack. i'll set an alert: cloudwatch/ops/compat_error_rate > 1.5% -> pager. oncall will watch logs and metrics for the first 45m.

Natalie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/789 - added release-note bullet + checklist. also adding a small SDK handshake change in: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1345

Maria: config snippet for the heuristics (to be added to deploybot config):

```
{
  "compat_threshold": 0.8,
  "deadman_minutes": 30,
  "fallback_strategy": "regional_variant",
  "model_group_exceptions": ["longseq-quant"]
}
```

Sam: please ensure deploybot emits `compat_alert` events to sqs/topic so the paging rules and incident responders get a clear signal. also include the canary run id in logs.

devops-bot: CI: canary job started -> canary-run-4123456789. logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/canary-run-4123456789

Kevin: :eyes: i'll watch the logs. if we see a spike i will run the rollback command and notify @eng-releases and @support.

Maria: thanks. if canary stays green for 2h we'll lift pin in the soft-unpin window and schedule a full rollout. i'll follow up in release notes once the soft-unpin is confirmed.

Natalie: :thumbsup:

Sam: tagging docs — please add a short note on the SDK compat handshake and the new `compat_score` attribute.

Maria: will do a post-canary summary here with the final decision and the exact time window for lifting the pin.
